papers.title: SphereVAD: Training-Free Video Anomaly Detection via Geodesic Inference on the Unit Hypersphere
papers.authors: Chao Huang, Penfei Wei, Wei Wang, Jie Wen, Zhihua Wang, Li Shen, Wenqi Ren, Xiaochun Cao
papers.affiliations: Shenzhen Campus of Sun Yat-sen University; Harbin Institute of Technology, Shenzhen
papers.intro: SphereVAD提出了一种完全无需训练的视频异常检测框架，将异常判别转化为单位超球面上的von Mises-Fisher（vMF）似然比测地线推理，通过利用预训练MLLM中间层特征的潜在几何判别性，仅需约2000张合成图像进行校准即可实现零样本检测。

papers.title: Uncertainty Quantification for Cardiac Shape Reconstruction with Deep Signed Distance Functions via MCMC methods
papers.authors: Jan Verhülsdonk, Thomas Grandits, Francisco Sahli Costabal, Thomas Beiert, Simone Pezzuto, Alexander Effland
papers.affiliations:
Jan Verhülsdonk - Institute for Applied Mathematics, University of Bonn, Germany
Thomas Grandits - Department of Mathematics and Scientific Computing, University of Graz, Austria and NAWI Graz
Francisco Sahli Costabal - Institute for Biological and Medical Engineering, Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile, Chile
Thomas Beiert - Heart Centre Bonn, Department of Medicine II, University Hospital Bonn, Germany
Simone Pezzuto - Laboratory of Mathematics for Biology and Medicine, Department of Mathematics, University of Trento, Italy, and with the Euler Institute, Università della Svizzera italiana, Switzerland
Alexander Effland - Institute for Applied Mathematics, University of Bonn, Germany
papers.intro: 提出一个结合DeepSDF与MCMC（特别是HMC/NUTS）的贝叶斯框架，首次实现对心脏双心室形状重建的不确定性量化，从稀疏点云获得准确重建和校准良好的不确定性估计。

papers.title: Seeing Across Skies and Streets: Feedforward 3D Reconstruction from Satellite, Drone, and Ground Images
papers.authors: Qiwei Wang, Zhongyao Tuo, Xianghui Ze, Yujiao Shi
papers.affiliations: Qiwei Wang - ShanghaiTech University; Zhongyao Tuo - ShanghaiTech University; Xianghui Ze - Nanjing University of Science and Technology; Yujiao Shi - ShanghaiTech University
papers.intro: 提出Cross3R，一种前馈模型，可同时从卫星、无人机和地面图像中恢复跨视角3D点云、所有输入相机的6自由度姿态，以及每个透视相机在卫星图上的(x,y)位置和偏航角。

papers.title: HEART: Hyperspherical Embedding Alignment via Kent-Representation Traversal in Diffusion Models
papers.authors: Arani Roy, Shristi Das Biswas, Kaushik Roy
papers.affiliations: Purdue University
papers.intro: 本文发现文本编码器的嵌入空间具有超球面几何，概念表现为各向异性的Kent分布，并据此提出HEART——一个无需训练、通过测地线变换实现主体替换和属性精细控制的框架。

papers.title: Delta-Adapter: Scalable Exemplar-Based Image Editing with Single-Pair Supervision
papers.authors: Jiacheng Chen, Songze Li, Han Fu, Baoquan Zhao, Wei Liu, Yanyan Liang, Li Qing, Xudong Mao
papers.affiliations:
Jiacheng Chen - Sun Yat-sen University
Songze Li - Sun Yat-sen University
Han Fu - Sun Yat-sen University
Baoquan Zhao - Sun Yat-sen University
Wei Liu - Video Rebirth
Yanyan Liang - Macau University of Science and Technology
Qing Li - The Hong Kong Polytechnic University
Xudong Mao - Sun Yat-sen University
papers.intro: 本文提出Delta-Adapter，通过从单个源-目标图像对中提取“语义增量”（semantic delta）并经由感知器适配器（Perceiver adapter）注入预训练编辑模型，在无需文本指导的情况下实现了示例驱动的图像编辑，将训练数据要求从“成对监督”降为“单对监督”。

papers.title: MedVIGIL: Evaluating Trustworthy Medical VLMs Under Broken Visual Evidence
papers.authors: Hanqi Jiang, Junhao Chen, Yi Pan, Lifeng Chen, Weihang You, Haozhen Gong, Ruiyu Yan, Jinglei Lv, Lin Zhao, Hui Ren, Quanzheng Li, Tianming Liu, Xiang Li
papers.tags: image captioning, image classification, Image Feature Extraction, Mask Generation
papers.affiliations: 作者列表、所属机构、
papers.intro: 本文提出MedVIGIL，一个由四位放射科医生全程监督的评估套件，通过八种证据扰动探针测试医学VLM在视觉证据破坏时的沉默失败行为，并引入MedVIGIL Composite Score (MCS) 综合评估能力、安全性和视觉接地。

papers.title: LiteGUI: Distilling Compact GUI Agents with Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Yubin Wu, Zicheng Cai, Liping Ning, Hua Wang, Zhi Chen, Yaohua Tang, Hao Chen
papers.affiliations: Moore Threads AI
papers.intro: LiteGUI提出一种无SFT的新训练范式，通过结合指导性在线蒸馏（Guided-OPD）和多解双级GRPO（MD-GRPO），显著释放2B-3B规模轻量级GUI代理的潜力，使其性能超越传统模仿学习限制，并达到与大规模模型竞争的水平。

papers.title: ActCam: Zero-Shot Joint Camera and 3D Motion Control for Video Generation
papers.authors: Omar El Khalifi, Thomas Rossi, Oscar Fossey, Thibault Fouque, Ulysse Mizrahi, Philip Torr, Ivan Laptev, Fabio Pizzati, Baptiste Bellot-Gurlet
papers.tags: Video Classification, 3D reconstruction, pose estimation, image-to-video
papers.affiliations: Kinetix, France（前五位及最后一位）；University of Oxford, United Kingdom（Philip Torr）；MBZUAI, United Arab Emirates（Ivan Laptev, Fabio Pizzati）
papers.intro: ActCam是一种零样本方法，通过构建相机对齐的姿态和深度条件以及两阶段去噪调度，在预训练图像到视频扩散模型上实现对角色动作和相机轨迹的联合控制。

papers.title: Relit-LiVE: Relight Video by Jointly Learning Environment Video
papers.authors: Weiqing Xiao, Hong Li, Xiuyu Yang, Houyuan Chen, Wenyi Li, Tianqi Liu, Shaocong Xu, Chongjie Ye, Hao Zhao, Beibei Wang
papers.affiliations: Nanjing University, BAAI, BUAA, Tsinghua University, The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, The Chinese University of Hong Kong (Shenzhen)
papers.intro: 提出Relit-LiVE框架，通过RGB-内在融合渲染器和联合生成环境视频的方式，无需相机位姿先验即可生成物理一致、时间稳定的视频重光照结果。

papers.title: GlazyBench: A Benchmark for Ceramic Glaze Property Prediction and Image Generation
papers.authors: Ziyu Zhai, Siyou Li, Juexi Shao, Juntao Yu
papers.affiliations: Queen Mary University of London
papers.intro: 提出GlazyBench，首个面向陶瓷釉料设计的标准化基准数据集，支持原料到烧后表面性能预测以及基于性能的图像生成两大任务，并建立了全面的基线模型。

papers.title: DPM++: Dynamic Masked Metric Learning for Occluded Person Re-identification
papers.authors: Lei Tan, Yingshi Luan, Pincong Zou, Pingyang Dai, Liujuan Cao
papers.affiliations: Key Laboratory of Multimedia Trusted Perception and Efficient Computing, Ministry of Education of China, Xiamen University
papers.intro: 本文提出 DPM++，一个动态掩码度量学习框架，通过CLIP引导的语义先验注入、显著性引导的补丁传输合成真实遮挡样本，以及输入自适应的原型掩码匹配，实现了遮挡行人重识别的SOTA性能。

papers.title: DPM++: Dynamic Masked Metric Learning for Occluded Person Re-identification
papers.authors: Lei Tan, Yingshi Luan, Pincong Zou, Pingyang Dai, Liujuan Cao
papers.affiliations: Key Laboratory of Multimedia Trusted Perception and Efficient Computing, Ministry of Education of China, Xiamen University, P.R. China
papers.intro: 论文提出DPM++，一个动态掩码度量学习框架，通过输入自适应的原型掩码在CLIP语义增强的类原型空间中实现遮挡行人的局部到整体可见一致性匹配，并利用显著性引导的补丁迁移合成真实遮挡样本以强化训练。

papers.title: SoftSAE: Dynamic Top-K Selection for Adaptive Sparse Autoencoders
papers.authors: Jakub Stępień, Marcin Mazur, Jacek Tabor, Przemysław Spurek
papers.affiliations: Jagiellonian University（前三作者）；Przemysław Spurek 还隶属于 IDEAS Research Institute
papers.intro: 本文提出 SoftSAE，利用可微的 Soft Top-K 算子，通过一个动态稀疏度预测网络为每个输入自适应地选择激活特征的数量，无需全局固定稀疏参数，实现了更匹配数据复杂度的特征分解。

papers.title: DINORANKCLIP: DINOv3 Distillation and Injection for Vision-Language Pretraining with High-Order Ranking Consistency
papers.authors: Shuyang Jiang, Nan Yu, Yiming Zhang, Zenghui Ding, Zhenyu Wu
papers.affiliations: UCLA, Aimaikj, HFIPS/CAS, USTC, NUDT
papers.intro: DINORANKCLIP通过冻结DINOv3教师的知识蒸馏与冲突感知融合注入密集局部结构先验，并引入高阶Plackett-Luce排序模型（包含二阶、三阶过渡项），在72小时CC3M训练中一致超越CLIP、CyCLIP、ALIP和RANKCLIP，特别是在细粒度和分布外评测上取得最大相对提升。

papers.title: MedHorizon: Towards Long-context Medical Video Understanding in the Wild
papers.authors: Bodong Du, Bowen Liu, Yang Yu, Xinpeng Ding, Zhiheng Wu, Shuning Wang, Shuo Nie, Naiming Liu, Qifeng Chen, Yangqiu Song, Xiaomeng Li
papers.affiliations: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, Baidu Inc., Xidian University
papers.intro: MedHorizon 是一个面向野外现场的长上下文医疗视频理解基准，包含759小时完整手术和检查视频、1253个证据驱动的多选问题，揭示了当前多模态大模型在极端稀疏证据场景下仅达到41.1%准确率，并诊断出检索瓶颈、注意力漂移等核心缺陷。

papers.title: DCR: Counterfactual Attractor Guidance for Rare Compositional Generation
papers.authors: Taewon Kang, Matthias Zwicker
papers.affiliations: University of Maryland at College Park, United States
papers.intro: 提出Default Completion Repulsion (DCR)，一种训练免费框架，通过构造反事实吸引器揭示模型的默认完成倾向，并在去噪过程中用投影内嵌排斥机制抑制该倾向，从而在不重新训练或修改架构的情况下显著提升稀有组合生成的保真度。

papers.title: FreeSpec: Training-Free Long Video Generation via Singular-Spectrum Reconstruction
papers.authors: Fangda Chen, Shanshan Zhao, Longrong Yang, Chuanfu Xu, Zhigang Luo, Long Lan
papers.affiliations: National University of Defense Technology; Alibaba International Digital Commerce; Zhejiang University; Xiangjiang Laboratory
papers.intro: FreeSpec 提出一种基于奇异谱重建的训练自由长视频生成框架，通过奇异值分解将全局分支作为低秩谱指导、局部分支作为高秩重建基，在避免预定义成分划分的同时，同时保持长程一致性和丰富的空间细节与时间动态。

papers.title: MARBLE: Multi-Aspect Reward Balance for Diffusion RL
papers.authors: Canyu Zhao, Hao Chen, Yunze Tong, Yu Qiao, Jiacheng Li, Chunhua Shen
papers.affiliations: 1 Zhejiang University, 2 HiThink, 3 Zhejiang University of Technology
papers.intro: MARBLE 提出一种梯度空间的多奖励平衡框架，通过逐奖励优势分解、梯度归一化与二次规划协调，在不依赖手动权重的情况下同时提升所有奖励维度，并利用摊销公式将训练成本降至接近单奖励基线。

papers.title: GeoStack: A Framework for Quasi-Abelian Knowledge Composition in VLMs
papers.authors: Pranav Mantini, Shishir K. Shah
papers.affiliations: University of Houston；The University of Oklahoma
papers.intro: GeoStack提出一种模块化知识组合框架，通过为每个领域训练带有几何约束（上三角闭包和正交性损失）的适配器（GeoLayers），使得多个独立训练的专家可以通过矩阵乘法顺序堆叠并折叠为单一权重，实现常数时间O(1)的推理复杂度，显著缓解灾难性遗忘。

papers.title: FREPix: Frequency-Heterogeneous Flow Matching for Pixel-Space Image Generation
papers.authors: Mingfeng Lin, Jiakun Chen, Liang Han, Liqiang Nie
papers.affiliations: Harbin Institute of Technology (Shenzhen)
papers.intro: 本文提出FREPix，一个频率异构流匹配框架，通过将像素空间图像显式分解为低频和高频分量，分配异构插值路径，使用解耦网络分别预测，并设计频率对齐目标函数，将粗到细生成从隐式行为转变为显式设计原则，在ImageNet上实现竞争性FID（256×256: 1.91, 512×512: 2.38）且在低N…
